partner.result_applied: The dependence-blind same-bank L^3 x L^(3/2) interface is false: a nonlinear residual law can cancel the apparent third square and retain a rank-two logarithm despite bounded residual joint and marginal densities. It is not a QFORM counterexample because the residual triple is not an orthogonal linear projection of independent originals.

new_results.statement: For arbitrary independent cap-one H,X1,X2,X3,X4 and all theta in R, with L=(X1-X3)/sqrt(2), P=(X1+X3)/sqrt(2), S=(X2+X4)/sqrt(2), the strict target form Q_theta=theta H^2+2sqrt(2)HL+2P^2+4LS has an absolutely continuous law with ||p_Qtheta||_(infinity,ess)<=3. Conditioning on original (H,X4) gives 2sqrt(2)YU+2V^2 where Y is independent of the cap-one joint pair (U,V), and the zero-pivot trace matrix has determinant -4.

The published r39 opposite-sign family whose absolute two-bank TT* kernel diverges already contains a fixed nonsingular zero-diagonal original physical triple of determinant -4 and spectrum {2,+sqrt(2),-sqrt(2)}. Therefore that example is a proof-norm barrier inside an already-paid localized branch, not by itself an analytic obstruction in the final diffuse ultra-coloop collar.

rank_two_log_control: In the same product construction, deleting 2V^2 and taking centered unit uniforms gives R=2sqrt(2)UX2 with p_R(t)>=(1/2)log(1/(2|t|)) for 0<|t|<1/2. Restoring 2V^2 removes the logarithm through the same-source curved joint pair (U,V) and a fresh independent scalar Y; no independence of U and V is asserted.
